title: The image wallpaper plugin should allow changing the scaling method
line: Image and slideshow wallpapers get a "Smooth scaling" checkbox; turning it off keeps pixel art and other small images sharp when enlarged.
explanation: The Image and Slideshow wallpapers always drew the picture with linear texture filtering (TransientImage hardcoded QSGTexture::Linear, and AnimatedImage used its smooth default). Low-resolution pixel art, including animated GIFs, therefore turned into a blurry mess once stretched to the screen, and there was no way to change it. The change adds a SmoothScaling config entry (default on) with a "Smooth scaling" checkbox under Positioning, and passes it down to every image item: TransientImage uses nearest filtering when its smooth property is off, and AnimatedImage and the day-night images get smooth bound to it.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: add an option to turn off smooth scaling

Image wallpapers were always scaled with linear filtering, which blurs
pixel art and other low-resolution images when they are enlarged. A new
"Smooth scaling" checkbox lets the user switch to sharp scaling instead.

BUG: 474184

patches.diff:

From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 21:50:55 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wallpapers/image: add an option to turn off smooth scaling

Image wallpapers were always scaled with linear filtering, which blurs
pixel art and other low-resolution images when they are enlarged. A new
"Smooth scaling" checkbox lets the user switch to sharp scaling instead.

BUG: 474184

diff --git a/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/config/main.xml b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/config/main.xml
index 1c47869b78..c1148969f9 100644
--- a/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/config/main.xml
+++ b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/config/main.xml
@@ -36,6 +36,10 @@
       <label>Sizing, cropping and positioning of the wallpaper image</label>
       <default>2</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="SmoothScaling" type="bool">
+      <label>Use smooth filtering when scaling the wallpaper image</label>
+      <default>true</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="SlideshowFoldersFirst" type="bool">
       <label>Display folders first when on slideshow</label>
       <default>false</default>

@@ -15,6 +15,7 @@ QQC2.StackView {
     id: view
 
     required property int fillMode

     required property string configColor
     required property bool blur
     property alias source: mediaProxy.source
@@ -39,6 +40,7 @@ QQC2.StackView {
     property Component dayNightComponent
 
     onFillModeChanged: Qt.callLater(loadImage);
+    onSmoothScalingChanged: Qt.callLater(loadImage);

     onBlurChanged: Qt.callLater(loadImage);
@@ -93,6 +95,7 @@ QQC2.StackView {

             "source": mediaProxy.modelImage,
             "fillMode": view.fillMode,
+            "smoothScaling": view.smoothScaling,
             "sourceSize": view.sourceSize,
             "color": view.configColor,
             "blur": view.blur,
diff --git a/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/config.qml b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/config.qml
index 533cc1fff8..56312828e6 100644
--- a/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/config.qml
+++ b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/config.qml
@@ -34,6 +34,8 @@ ColumnLayout {
     property string cfg_ImageDefault
     property int cfg_FillMode
     property int cfg_FillModeDefault
+    property alias cfg_SmoothScaling: smoothScalingCheckBox.checked
+    property bool cfg_SmoothScalingDefault
     property int cfg_SlideshowMode
     property int cfg_SlideshowModeDefault
     property bool cfg_SlideshowFoldersFirst
@@ -191,6 +193,23 @@ ColumnLayout {
             }
         }
 
+        RowLayout {
+            spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+
+            QtControls2.CheckBox {
+                id: smoothScalingCheckBox
+                text: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.image", "@option:check", "Smooth scaling")
+
+                KCM.SettingHighlighter {
+                    highlight: root.cfg_SmoothScalingDefault != root.cfg_SmoothScaling
+                }
+            }
+
+            Kirigami.ContextualHelpButton {
+                toolTipText: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.image", "@info:tooltip", "Turn this off to keep pixel art and other low-resolution images sharp when they are enlarged.")
+            }
+        }
+
         QtControls2.ButtonGroup { id: dayNightModeGroup }

diff --git a/wallpapers/image/plugin/transientimage.cpp b/wallpapers/image/plugin/transientimage.cpp

media.caption: A 40x25 pixel-art PNG as wallpaper: always blurred when scaled up
Same wallpaper with Smooth scaling turned off: crisp pixels
Animated pixel-art GIF wallpaper (the reporter's case): blurred
Same GIF, still animating, with Smooth scaling off: sharp
New "Smooth scaling" checkbox with a help button explaining when to turn it off
